minimum_distance_exactly_three: Distinct nonzero columns exclude weights 1 and 2; the verified three distinct positions sum to zero.
established_scope: The primary matrix has rank 10 and defines a binary [51,41] code of covering radius exactly 2 and minimum distance 3.
The primary eleven-block and KSL ten-block position partitions are (2,0)-partitions of this exact ordered matrix.
The constructive upper bound p_min(H_KR) <= 10 and Remark 7.2's stated reversal control are reproduced.
not_checked: No SAT solving, LRAT replay, Lean checking, or verification of the lower bound p_min >= 10.
No conclusion about a different 51-column seed or the published length-415 certificate.
No submission, external contact, or claim of human expert review.
